issue.title: Obsidian CDP runners inherit a long TMPDIR and abort on SingletonSocket
issue.description: The ownership phase observed all three owned Obsidian launches abort before assertions with Chromium FATAL Socket path too long: <agent-tmp>/scoped_dir.../SingletonSocket. Root cause: Chromium inherits the long SASE TMPDIR, exceeding the AF_UNIX socket path limit. TMPDIR=/tmp/<short> made the same suites launch. Repair the runner launch environment with a short per-run temporary base; retain isolated profile/vault/port/process cleanup. Add a long-TMPDIR regression. Related closed bob-cli-5b fixed only the Python web-clip self-test; do not reopen that completed adapter task. This is bounded runner environment plumbing; small size.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: All three runners fail at startup with the same fatal path error; shortening TMPDIR permits the same commands to execute.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-nh.6.1.1 note 6; deterministic launch failure prevents real acceptance under the SASE agent environment.

payload.description: Related runner or workflow; distinct remediation described in task

evidence.note: Proposed by bob-cli-o6.4.1.1 note #5: inherited SASE TMPDIR makes album runner Chromium abort with Socket path too long / SingletonSocket; TMPDIR=/tmp works. Source audit at b8b7baf confirms album childEnv spreads process.env without overriding TMPDIR and bank launch uses os.tmpdir(), while preview-property-cards pins /tmp. Also reviewed bob-cli-o6.4.1.3 #6 (raw snap executable startup failure; snap wrapper works): do not assume a separate executable defect, since later album report file:explicit:5911d19e7c9aae058cbad08d and full record report file:explicit:f0c604b18ca234048e388234 successfully use the raw executable. Preserve this launch symptom in the short-TMPDIR investigation; changing the default binary is not justified by current evidence.

evidence.note: bob-cli-on.10.1.4 (note #3) hit the same launch-environment class in the new scripts/obsidian-task-reqs-e2e.cjs: besides the 108-byte SingletonSocket limit (fixed there with /tmp scratch paths), Electron stalls on athena unless the scratch app gets DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=disabled: — the agent shell exports the real user session bus, so DevTools never answers, the update check never finishes, and the --help probe spawns the app on the default profile. obsidian-task-reqs-e2e.cjs (bob-plugins 7b96dce) now carries launchEnv/scratchBase/probeExecutable helpers (private profile, process-group kill, short scratch base, DBUS disabled) that the other obsidian-*-e2e.cjs runners could share; the fix for this bead should cover the DBUS stall too.
